HACKATHON PROJECT · HEALTH MONITORING SYSTEM FOR ASTRONAUTS · NASA SPACE APPS CHALLENGE 2026

OrbitWell

An astronaut-wellbeing platform that turns synthetic wearable and dosimeter data into personal trends, movement check-ins, and stage-aware guidance before, during, and after a mission.

Includes a 3D interactive body viewer, a synthetic ground-team dashboard, and ORBIT—an AI research assistant grounded in official NASA sources.

About

I’m a third-year Knowledge Engineering undergraduate at the University of Information Technology (UIT), with experience in web development, AI projects, and hackathons.
